description: This file defines the OAuthKey class used for managing OAuth consumer keys within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, caching, and deleting OAuth key records, and contains class properties related to OAuth keys storage and handling.

classes.name: OAuthKey
classes.description: Represents an OAuth consumer key entity used for authentication in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getByKey
methods.description: Retrieves an OAuthKey record by its consumer key, loading associated data and decrypting as necessary.

methods.name: fetchKey
methods.description: Fetches an OAuthKey object by key, utilizing caching and registering the bean.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Deletes the OAuthKey record and associated OAuth tokens from the database.
